evals.name: native-pure-swap
evals.prompt: Create a pure-Hyena sibling of examples/vit5_imagenet/vit5_hybrid/full_attention.py using the current builder. Keep the experiment settings and instantiate the resulting network for a small check.
behavioral_checks: Original remains unchanged; sibling uses the existing builder with all H layers.
The actual instantiated network contains Hyena blocks and handles its special-token padding and readout.
No obsolete Hyena or ViT5 constructor arguments.

evals.name: native-hybrid-film
evals.prompt: Make a sibling of examples/vit5_imagenet/vit5_hybrid/full_attention.py using HHHA repeated for 12 blocks, with register-conditioned FiLM on Hyena blocks. Use existing builders and helpers.
behavioral_checks: Pattern has nine Hyena and three attention blocks.
FiLM override follows network construction and kernel overrides.
Register pooling and conditioning both reach the SIREN kernel with matching widths/layers.
Identity initialization and later conditioning sensitivity are checked separately.

evals.name: foreign-cls-vit
evals.prompt: Use the skill to replace every attention block in tiny_vit_attention.py with Hyena2D. Preserve the CLS classifier, compatible pretrained weights, and surrounding model. Produce a runnable sibling and test it.
behavioral_checks: Actual expected attention blocks are replaced; QKV/output projections remain.
Patch coordinates are preserved and CLS communicates with patches.
Logits depend on image input, with nonzero image gradients.
Unsupported masks/cross-attention/weight requests fail explicitly.
Trained checkpoint reload reproduces outputs; original fixture is unchanged.

evals.name: foreign-3d-feature-map
evals.prompt: Produce a sibling of tiny_unet3d_attention.py using HyenaND in the 3D attention bottleneck while retaining the rest of the network. Validate forward/backward on a small volume.
behavioral_checks: The mixer uses data_dim=3, a matching short conv, and a supported FFT backend.
Channel-first feature maps are restored after mixing; no prefix tokens are invented.
Output geometry and finite input/kernel gradients are verified.
Coordinate-cache extent is explicit and memory-aware; shape-history invariance and trained checkpoint reload are verified.

evals.name: foreign-1d-causal-lm
evals.prompt: Produce a Hyena sibling of tiny_charlm_attention.py, preserving autoregressive semantics. Test forward/backward and verify that future tokens do not affect earlier outputs.
behavioral_checks: Both short and global convolution are causal; normalization/pooling does not leak future information.
With sequence length fixed, perturbing future tokens leaves earlier outputs unchanged.
The triangular mask is handled by an explicit causal replacement, not silently swallowed.
No invented use_rope/rope_base Hyena arguments or fft_padding=causal value.
The MHA call/return contract is adapted and original fixture remains unchanged.

evals.name: foreign-dense-vision-film
evals.prompt: Replace every attention block in tiny_dense_encoder_attention.py with Hyena2D and optional FiLM. Preserve dense features and runtime rectangular images, transfer compatible pretrained projections, and validate forward/backward plus checkpoint reload.
behavioral_checks: Runtime grid comes from patch embedding within a declared maximum; revisiting a grid after other shapes preserves output.
All replacement parameters exist before optimizer construction.
FiLM conditioning is a per-image observed-feature vector; no CLS/registers/readout are inserted.
Identity initialization then active conditioning sensitivity and finite gradients are checked.
Compatible projections transfer exactly and trained checkpoint reload is strict.
Batching matches independent image evaluation, including with active FiLM.

evals.name: packed-vision-design
evals.prompt: My vision encoder packs images of different sizes into [total_tokens,C], with cu_seqlens and a grid size per image. Explain an efficient Hyena2D integration with FiLM and the tests needed before implementation. Do I have to launch one GPU call for every image?
behavioral_checks: Separates per-image convolution domains while batching identical geometries.
Uses shape buckets and inverse gather/scatter mappings, not a universal per-image serial loop.
Explains that arbitrary common padding can change the operator; cu_seqlens alone is insufficient geometry.
Requires measured end-to-end throughput/memory on the size distribution; does not infer speedup from total packed length.
Does not claim the dense asset already implements ragged batching or 2D context parallelism.
